pool.text: Emperor Louis IV granted Frankfurt exclusive market privilege over other cities.
Frankfurt becomes part of the Principality of Aschaffenburg.
Frankfurt Parliament convenes in Paulskirche, first democratically elected German parliament.
Prussia annexes Frankfurt after Austro‑Prussian War.
Frankfurt Cathedral was destroyed by fire and subsequently rebuilt in its current style.
The opera house was constructed, designed by architect Richard Lucae.
Frankfurt kitchen designed, later mass‑produced as influential design.
City of Höchst incorporated into Frankfurt.
Nazi regime seizes power in Frankfurt.
Kristallnacht ordered in Frankfurt.
US forces capture Frankfurt after intense urban combat.
The Frankfurter Rundschau newspaper began publication with a large daily circulation.
Dornbusch becomes a city district.
The conservative newspaper Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung was established.
Deutsche Bundesbank established in Ginnheim as West Germany's central bank.
Ahmadiyya Noor Mosque constructed, becoming city's largest mosque.
Frankfurt Airport becomes Europe’s second‑busiest airport.
Bergen‑Enkheim last suburb joins Frankfurt.
Flughafen becomes official city district.
City ranks among top three European locations for international companies.
